title: Local reindexing of sheets in a commuting square
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $B_fT=T\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $W,T_1,T_2,Z$ be objects of $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with $h_i:T_i\to W$, $g_i:Z\to T_i$ and $h_1g_1=h_2g_2$. Given explicit splittings $D_i$ with index sets $J_i$ as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-splitting-data], there is a covering presieve $R$ on $Z$ such that for every $k:Q\to Z$ in $R$ there is a bijection $e:J_1\simeq J_2$ with $B_f(h_1)\circ\sigma_{1,j}\circ g_1\circ k=B_f(h_2)\circ\sigma_{2,e(j)}\circ g_2\circ k$ for every sheet $j$. The presieve may be empty when $Z$ is empty.

source.place: Section 03SH (section-trace-method), paragraph after Definition 03SE; descent details as in SGA 4, Expose IX, 5.1.

proof.text: Pull D1,D2 back along g1,g2 with the explicit splitting pullback theorem. Obtain E1,E2 over Z and bijections e1,e2 with section compatibility.

The inverse projection identities convert the cocone of each E into a coproduct cocone of copies of Z: define descent by first projecting each old piece to Z; the inverse identities prove its factorization and uniqueness. Apply the finite-section-coproduct local permutation theorem to obtain a neighbourhood U_z and a matching bijection for every point z of Z.

Regard U_z as an etale X-scheme and its inclusion k_z as a site arrow. Let R be their ofArrows presieve. Each point z is in the range of k_z, so the small etale jointly-surjective criterion proves it covers; an empty Z gives an empty point-indexed covering. On k_z use e1, the local matching bijection and inverse e2 as the final bijection. Rewrite sections by the transport equations. Functoriality and g1 followed by h1 equals g2 followed by h2 identify the induced maps to B_f(W). Compose the local equality to give the desired equality.

lean.statement: theorem finiteEtaleTrace_split_reindexing {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : Etale f) : let B := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f ⋙ MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hf ∀ (W T₁ T₂ Z : X.Etale) (h₁ : T₁ ⟶ W) (h₂ : T₂ ⟶ W) (g₁ : Z ⟶ T₁) (g₂ : Z ⟶ T₂), g₁ ≫ h₁ = g₂ ≫ h₂ → ∀ (D₁ : FiniteEtaleTraceSplitting f T₁) (D₂ : FiniteEtaleTraceSplitting f T₂), ∃ R : Presieve Z, Sieve.generate R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology Z ∧ ∀ (Q : X.Etale) (k : Q ⟶ Z), R k → ∃ e : D₁.J ≃ D₂.J, ∀ j, k ≫ g₁ ≫ D₁.sectionMap hf j ≫ B.map h₁ = k ≫ g₂ ≫ D₂.sectionMap hf (e j) ≫ B.map h₂
